example: Example run with fictional figures: Northbrook Trading, IFRS statements for the year to 30 June 2026, in thousands of US dollars. The figures match the worked examples on the step-by-step page.

chosen.northbrook-fy2025-statements.pdf: the name of the user's own file of last year's statements as issued
chosen.bank-loan-schedule.xlsx: the name of the user's own loan amortization schedule

messages.text: Can you build our year-end financial statements? The bank wants them.
Yes. Before I read anything, I need some answers. I ask them all at once, so the run does not stop again for each one.
list: Do you want me to use MosoFin, or will you upload the data?
Which framework: US GAAP, IFRS, a local GAAP or a special basis? What is the legal form of the company?
Which period, and which columns: the year only, or also the prior year or the budget?
Is this one company, or a group? For a group, do you want consolidated or separate statements?
Please attach last year's statements as issued.
How do you know which part of each loan is due within twelve months? Please attach the schedules.
Do you want whole dollars, thousands or millions?
Do you want the income statement by function or by nature?
Is there anything special, such as discontinued operations, segments or earnings per share?
messages.after: The questions on last year's statements, the loans and the rounding are optional. Without them, I name what is missing and never guess.

messages.text: Use MosoFin. IFRS, and we are a private limited company. Year to 30 June 2026, with last year beside it. One company. Last year's statements and the loan schedule are attached. Thousands, by nature, non-current items first. Nothing special.

messages.label: Checked the workspace and the company file
rows: QuickBooks, Northbrook Trading, confirmed by name
messages.summary: The agent can read your books. It cannot change them.

messages.text: Here is my plan. I build **IFRS** statements for **Northbrook Trading** for the year to **30 June 2026**, with one comparative year. I read the trial balance from your books, on the accrual basis. I present by nature, non-current items first, in **thousands**. The loan split comes from your schedule. I check last year against your FY2025 statements. Shall I start?

messages.label: Read both year ends in one batch
rows: Platform version, loan as one line of 120
messages.summary: 7 reads in one batch. Nothing in your books changed.

messages.text: The trial balance balances. Debits and credits are both **1,551** thousand, so the difference is 0. The year is not closed, so I use the year-to-date balances. One account needs your answer before I map it. **Ask My Accountant** holds a debit of 2 thousand. What is it?
That is a deposit we paid to a supplier.

Then it belongs in **Prepayments**, which becomes 12. I put the entry on the reclassifications sheet as a proposal. All 21 accounts now land on exactly one line. Your schedule puts 40 of the 120 loan due within twelve months, so I split it:

messages.after: Your platform's balance sheet shows the loan as one long-term line. That puts current liabilities at 104 instead of 144. After the split, I proved the balance again: 516 equals 224 plus 292.

messages.after: Other comprehensive income is nil, so total comprehensive income is also 38. With dividends of 15, retained earnings close at 242.

messages.text: Your workpaper has eight sheets. There is no separate comprehensive income sheet, because you have no other comprehensive income. Every statement has a footer with the entity, source, currency and rounding.
messages.after: These are management's own statements. They are not audited, reviewed or compiled, and I write no notes. Ask the bank which level it needs. Do you want an Excel file, and a PDF copy too?

messages.text: Excel only, please. Can you also post the supplier deposit entry?

Here is **Financial_Statements_2026-06_Northbrook Trading.xlsx**. I do not post entries. The reclassifications sheet has the draft: debit Prepayments 2, credit Ask My Accountant 2. Your bookkeeper posts it.
messages.after: Do you want me to save your settings for next year?

messages.text: Done. I saved the framework, the presentation choices, the account-to-line mapping, the loan split rule, the rounding, the accrual basis and the comparative policy. I never save balances, statement figures or the trial balance.
